mnemonic.meaning: NAZE (why) + NARA (if): "if you ask why...".

examples.ja: 今日は休みます。なぜなら、熱があるからです。
examples.en: I'm taking today off. The reason is that I have a fever.

items.note: Usually なぜなら〜からだ. Formal; in speech people just say 〜から.

mnemonic.meaning: 候 wait + 補 supplement: someone waiting in line to fill a place.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, HO!" (こうほ) The candidate coughs, "Ho!"

examples.ja: 彼は次の社長の候補だ。
examples.en: He's a candidate for the next president.

items.note: Also options: 候補地 (candidate site).

mnemonic.meaning: 継 has 糸 (thread): continuing the thread.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUGU!" (つぐ) The son takes over: "Tsu-goo!"

examples.ja: 彼は父の店を継いだ。
examples.en: He took over his father's shop.

items.note: 跡を継ぐ = to follow in someone's footsteps. 次ぐ (also つぐ) = to rank next.

mnemonic.meaning: 冷 has 冫 (ice): it gets cold.
mnemonic.reading: "SAME-RU!" (さめる) Same as 冷ます (Level 1), but the thing cools by itself.

examples.ja: スープが冷めてしまった。
examples.en: The soup has gone cold.

items.note: Intransitive (it cools). 冷ます = you cool it. 覚める (also さめる) = to wake up.

mnemonic.meaning: 通 pass + 過 pass: pass through and past.
mnemonic.reading: TOORI (pass) + SUGIRU (go beyond): (とおりすぎる)

examples.ja: バスが止まらずに通り過ぎた。
examples.en: The bus went past without stopping.

items.note: Often "go past without stopping".

mnemonic.meaning: 雷 = 雨 (rain) + 田 (field): a storm crashing over the fields.
mnemonic.reading: "KAMI, NARI!" (かみなり) The gods (神) make noise (鳴り).

examples.ja: 夜中に雷が鳴った。
examples.en: Thunder rumbled in the middle of the night.

items.note: 雷が落ちる = lightning strikes. Also a scolding: 雷を落とす.

mnemonic.meaning: 地 earth + 味 flavour: an earthy, plain taste.
mnemonic.reading: "JEE, ME!" (じみ) Gee, it's plain.

examples.ja: 彼女はいつも地味な服を着ている。
examples.en: She always wears plain clothes.

items.note: Opposite: 派手 (はで, flashy). Not negative in itself; can mean modest.

mnemonic.meaning: 中 middle + 学 study: middle school.
mnemonic.reading: "CHUU, GAKU!" (ちゅうがく) Middle-school kids chew gum.

examples.ja: 中学のときはテニス部だった。
examples.en: In junior high, I was in the tennis club.

items.note: Short for 中学校. 中学生 = junior high student.

mnemonic.meaning: 負 lose: the losing side.
mnemonic.reading: "MAKE!" (まけ) Make no mistake: you lost.

examples.ja: 今回は私の負けだ。
examples.en: I lose this time.

items.note: Noun from 負ける. 勝ち = win. 負けず嫌い = hates to lose.

mnemonic.meaning: 校 school + 舎 building: the school building.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, SHA!" (こうしゃ) The school's cool shack.

examples.ja: 古い校舎が取り壊された。
examples.en: The old school building was torn down.

items.note: Just the building, not the school as an institution.

mnemonic.meaning: 身 body + 長 length: how long your body is.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIN, CHOU!" (しんちょう) Your shin is long.

examples.ja: 身長は何センチですか。
examples.en: How tall are you (in centimetres)?

items.note: Only for people. 高さ is the height of things.

mnemonic.meaning: 塔 has 土 (earth): a building rising from the earth.
mnemonic.reading: "TOU!" (とう) Tow it up the tower.

examples.ja: 寺には五重の塔がある。
examples.en: The temple has a five-storey pagoda.

items.note: 東京タワー uses タワー, but old towers and pagodas are 塔.

mnemonic.meaning: KOBORERU: "COBBLER" spills his tea. It spills over by itself.

examples.ja: コップから水がこぼれた。
examples.en: Water spilled from the glass.

items.note: Intransitive. Also 涙がこぼれる (tears fall). Kanji: 零れる.

mnemonic.meaning: KOBOSU: you're the BOSS who spills it. You spill something.

examples.ja: コーヒーをシャツにこぼした。
examples.en: I spilled coffee on my shirt.

items.note: Transitive partner of こぼれる. Also 愚痴をこぼす (to grumble).

mnemonic.meaning: 患 suffer illness + 者 person: a person suffering illness.
mnemonic.reading: "KAN, JA!" (かんじゃ) A patient waits for the doctor, "Can, ja?"

examples.ja: 医者は患者の話をよく聞いた。
examples.en: The doctor listened carefully to the patient.

items.note: Only for medical patients.

mnemonic.meaning: 神 spirit + 経 pass through: what spirits pass through in the body. Nerves.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIN, KAY!" (しんけい) Your shin's nerve is okay.

examples.ja: 試験の前は神経がぴりぴりする。
examples.en: I get on edge before exams.

items.note: 神経質 = nervous, sensitive. 無神経 = insensitive.

mnemonic.meaning: 大 big + 半 half: the bigger half.
mnemonic.reading: "TIE, HAN!" (たいはん) Tie up the bigger half.

examples.ja: 学生の大半が賛成した。
examples.en: Most of the students agreed.

items.note: Formal; ほとんど is close.

mnemonic.meaning: 尻 = 尸 (body) + 九: the rear end of the body.
mnemonic.reading: "SHEE, REE!" (しり) You sit on your behind.

examples.ja: 長く座っていたらお尻が痛くなった。
examples.en: My bum hurts from sitting so long.

items.note: お尻 is polite. Also the end of something: 列の尻.

mnemonic.meaning: 昼 noon, made polite with お.
mnemonic.reading: "OH, HEE-RU!" (おひる) Oh, it's noon.

examples.ja: お昼は何を食べる?
examples.en: What are you having for lunch?

items.note: Casual for 昼ご飯 or noon.

mnemonic.meaning: 嫁 = 女 (woman) + 家 (house): a woman who joins the house.
mnemonic.reading: "YOME!" (よめ) Yo, meet the bride.

examples.ja: 息子の嫁はとても優しい。
examples.en: My son's wife is very kind.

items.note: Daughter-in-law, or a casual "my wife" (some find it old-fashioned).

mnemonic.meaning: 畑 = 火 (fire) + 田 (rice field): a field cleared by fire. A dry field.
mnemonic.reading: "HATAKE!" (はたけ) Hatake: Kakashi's family name.

examples.ja: 祖父は畑で野菜を育てている。
examples.en: My grandfather grows vegetables in his field.

items.note: 畑 is a dry field. 田 (た) is a rice paddy. A Japanese-made kanji.

mnemonic.meaning: 婚 marriage + 約 promise: a promise of marriage.
mnemonic.reading: "KON, YAKU!" (こんやく) You promise to marry Kon.

examples.ja: 二人は去年婚約した。
examples.en: The two of them got engaged last year.

items.note: 婚約者 = fiancé(e). 婚約指輪 = engagement ring.

mnemonic.meaning: 国 country + 家 state: the country as a state.
mnemonic.reading: "KOKKA!" (こっか) The national flag is 国旗 (こっき), the anthem is 国歌 (also こっか).

examples.ja: 国家の安全を守る。
examples.en: We protect the security of the nation.

items.note: The country as a political state. 国 is general. 国歌 (anthem) sounds the same.

mnemonic.meaning: 賭 has 貝 (money): money on the line.
mnemonic.reading: "KAKERU!" (かける) Same sound as 掛ける and 駆ける.

examples.ja: 彼は全財産を賭けた。
examples.en: He bet everything he owned.

items.note: 命を賭ける = to risk your life. 賭け = a bet.

mnemonic.meaning: 捲 has 扌 (hand): the hand rolling something up.
mnemonic.reading: "ME, KURU!" (めくる) Turn the page and the next one comes (来る).

examples.ja: 本のページを捲った。
examples.en: I turned the page of the book.

items.note: Usually in kana: めくる. 腕まくり (rolling up sleeves) is related.

mnemonic.meaning: 悪 = 亜 + 心 (heart): a bad heart.
mnemonic.reading: "AKU!" (あく) Ack, evil.

examples.ja: 正義と悪の戦い。
examples.en: The battle between good and evil.

items.note: As a prefix: 悪口 (bad-mouthing), 悪影響 (bad influence).

mnemonic.meaning: 勘 has 力 (power): a hidden power of judgement.
mnemonic.reading: "KAN!" (かん) Can you sense it?

examples.ja: 私の勘では、彼は嘘をついている。
examples.en: My gut tells me he's lying.

items.note: 勘がいい = intuitive. 勘違い = misunderstanding.

mnemonic.meaning: 誇 has 言 (words): speaking proudly.
mnemonic.reading: "HOKORI!" (ほこり) Dust (埃) is also ほこり. Your pride gathers no dust.

examples.ja: 自分の仕事に誇りを持っている。
examples.en: I take pride in my work.

items.note: Positive pride. Same reading as 埃 (dust). 自慢 is boasting.

mnemonic.meaning: 丘 looks like a small hill with two bumps.
mnemonic.reading: "OKA!" (おか) Oh, car up the hill.

examples.ja: 丘の上から町が見える。
examples.en: You can see the town from the top of the hill.

items.note: Smaller than 山.

mnemonic.meaning: 小 small + 屋 house: a small house.
mnemonic.reading: "KO, YA!" (こや) A small shack, yeah.

examples.ja: 山の中に小さな小屋がある。
examples.en: There's a little hut in the mountains.

items.note: Also for animals: 犬小屋 (doghouse).
